submissions.decision-replacement-recruiting-month-cl: WITH totals AS (SELECT team_code, SUM(CASE WHEN start_month <= 4 AND 4 < start_month + term_months THEN total_cents / term_months ELSE 0 END) AS expense_cents, SUM(CASE WHEN paid_month = 4 THEN total_cents ELSE 0 END) AS cash_cents FROM vendor_charge GROUP BY team_code) SELECT team_code, expense_cents, cash_cents, expense_cents - cash_cents AS gap_cents FROM totals ORDER BY team_code ASC
submissions.decision-replay-clock-at-the-horn: WITH bounds AS (SELECT r.basket_id, r.cam_release - h.cam_sync + h.arena_sync - h.error_ms AS earliest_ms, r.cam_release - h.cam_sync + h.arena_sync + h.error_ms AS latest_ms, h.horn_ms, r.replay_ref, h.horn_ref FROM replay_marks AS r JOIN horn_certificates AS h ON h.period_id = r.period_id) SELECT basket_id, earliest_ms, latest_ms, CASE WHEN latest_ms < horn_ms THEN 'count' WHEN earliest_ms >= horn_ms THEN 'void' ELSE 'review' END AS ruling, replay_ref, horn_ref FROM bounds ORDER BY basket_id ASC
submissions.decision-replay-surviving-catalog-cell-e: WITH last_ticks AS (SELECT item_key, field_key, MAX(tick) AS current_tick, MAX(CASE WHEN origin_key <> 'spill' THEN tick END) AS restored_tick FROM cell_edit GROUP BY item_key, field_key) SELECT t.item_key, t.field_key, CASE WHEN r.cell_value IS NULL THEN 'clear' ELSE 'set' END AS edit_action, r.cell_value AS new_value FROM last_ticks AS t JOIN cell_edit AS c ON c.tick = t.current_tick JOIN cell_edit AS r ON r.tick = t.restored_tick WHERE c.cell_value COLLATE BINARY IS NOT r.cell_value ORDER BY t.item_key COLLATE BINARY ASC, t.field_key COLLATE BINARY ASC
submissions.decision-reserve-a-sorter-service-window: WITH ready_hours AS (SELECT hour_no, MAX(0, forecast_items - hand_capacity) AS delayed FROM sorter_hour WHERE crew_ready = 1 AND forecast_items IS NOT NULL AND hand_capacity IS NOT NULL) SELECT a.hour_no AS start_hour, MAX(a.delayed, b.delayed) AS peak_delayed, a.delayed + b.delayed AS total_delayed FROM ready_hours AS a JOIN ready_hours AS b ON b.hour_no = a.hour_no + 1 ORDER BY peak_delayed ASC, total_delayed ASC, start_hour ASC LIMIT 1
